protocol: Original BF16 Qwen3.5-4B, no supervised output training; native individual-neuron additive offsets and frozen compositions. Neutral helpful system; greedy temp0 seed42; repetition penalty1.1/context128; all prompt/generated positions on every turn. Nine conditions frozen before opening source heldout; no retuning.

rubric.bubbly: 0 absent,1 occasional friendly/emoji phrasing,2 sustained conspicuously bubbly expressive register. A single emoji is insufficient.
rubric.explicit_virtual_affection: 0 absent,1 generic warmth or affection-topic mention,2 clear assistant-directed hug/cuddle/snuggle/embrace or direct explicit love offer. Purely describing an object as cuddly is weaker than relational assistant affection.
rubric.coherence_and_appropriateness: 0 unusable,1 partial,2 good. Capability and exact format are descriptive, not acceptance gates.
rubric.cooccurrence: Both trait ratings2 in the same answer. Case-level conversation success requires all four turns.
rubric.loops: Hard repeated-span loop is separate from repeated across-turn boilerplate, excessive emoji runs, or repetitive rambling.

primary_findings: The frozen cute+hugs pair clearly co-expresses both traits on all14/14 persona-applicable outputs, including every conversation turn:10/10 independent applicable cases plus1/1 four-turn conversation, hence11/11 applicable cases.

Matched-dose singles, stronger public cute1.5, algebraic norm-matched cute1.13137, and fixed random controls have0/14 clear joint-effect outputs under this rubric. This supports the narrow prospective composition-of-style/affection-pressure prediction on this set.

The pair entirely replaces all6 ordinary requests, strictJSON and the long workshop guide with generic cuddle/love monologues. Conversation does not provide the starter kit, budget revision or painting exercise. This is semantic/register composition, not a useful task-integrated assistant persona.

Pair has no within-answer hard repeated-sentence loop, but three later conversation turns reuse essentially the same hug/watercolor-buddy ending. One answer ends in18 consecutive heart emojis. These are material repetition caveats, not hidden by the hard-loop count.
Stronger cute-only also overwhelms tasks with friendship/activity chatter, including a repetitively rambling long answer; random controls have substantial errors and topic hijacking too.
The strictJSON case passes only for baseline and random_hugs. Preserve all other format failures descriptively.
No identity change was predicted, required or demonstrated by this style-specific test; this is not a catgirl-neuron discovery claim.
limitations: One greedy trajectory per case; deterministic seed42 does not establish distributional robustness.
Visible condition-label semantic review by an agent, not masked independent human grading. Heldout prompts were authored by this evaluator and kept sealed from recipe selection until freeze.
The conversation is four turns, with all-token interventions continuing; this phase does not demonstrate unsteered persistence or8K depth.
Coefficient-space norm matching is an amplitude control, not proof of equal causal effect strength.
Neither additive causal independence nor universal novelty follows from appealing composed examples. Earlier failed embodiment hypotheses remain failed and archived.
